key_points: Vast majority of headlines are routine options chain listings (Yahoo Finance, moomoo) containing no fundamental or news information
Zacks reports PDD closed at $79.20, down 1.43% and underperforming the broader market on Sept 23 — a minor daily move
No earnings surprises, guidance changes, regulatory/legal events, M&A, or product/management news present in any headline
Remaining headlines are generic market commentary (e.g., 'PDD Stock Price Today', 'Real-Time Signals') classified as clickbait/low-value
Combined effect is essentially noise; no basis for changing the investment thesis
